_meta.note: theme suffix appended by SpriteAtlasManager.DoSpriteLookup (RVA 0x2B2F5B0) via EnumExtensions.GetName(tribe/skin) lowercased; terrain theme uses TileData.climate (TribeType int) + TileData._skin (SkinType).
_meta.fallback_rule: DoSpriteLookup tries baseName+'_'+skin then baseName+'_'+tribe(theme) then bare baseName. mountain/Forest have NO bare sprite, so a tribe theme suffix is mandatory; climate=Nature(1) has no art and resolves to a concrete tribe theme at map-gen (each tile's climate int is a real TribeType 2-17 in practice).

1.note: Nature: no ground_/mountain_/Forest_ art exists; placeholder climate only.

units.layer_model: unit = bodytint(player-color) + body(skin) + head(tribe) + weapon(class); each may have _Outline. Naming: body_<class>[_<skin>][_Outline]; head_<tribe|special>[_Outline]; weapon_<class>[_<skin>][_Outline]; bodytint_<class>[_<skin>][_Outline].
units.ship_units_prefix: unit_<shipclass> e.g. unit_ship, unit_boat, unit_battleship, unit_bombership, unit_scoutship, unit_transportship, unit_rammer, unit_pirate_ship, unit_cloak_boat, unit_juggernaut, unit_catapult_default, unit_aquapult_body; tintable via *tint*
